nodes.label: App Screenshot — Norton Commander Style
nodes.image_description: Dual-pane TUI file manager in classic Norton Commander / CGA blue palette (#0000AA background, #55FFFF cyan text). [Z]eta branded menu bar with File/Navigate/View/Help menus. Left pane: studyAI project directory listing. Right pane: Documents directory listing. Preview panel at bottom (empty). Workspace indicator top-right showing 4 workspaces (1:…/studyAI active). Status bar shows git branch (main), permissions, operation timing. Function key bar: Alt+1..4 Workspace, F1 Help, F3 View, F4 Edit, F5 Copy, F6 Rename, F7 Mkdir, F8 Delete, F10 Quit.
